text:
mia: Quick sync — we need a short PRD for rate limits / quotas + billing semantics for Q3 planning. Major asks from two customers: per-tenant burst windows, clear overage charging, and a way to opt into a shared pool. Can someone take point?

dan: I can own the PRD draft. Quick Qs: do we want to model quotas as token-based, request-count, or both? customers asked about both embedding tokens and generation tokens.

sanjay: recommend token-based primary, but we should capture request-level guards for abuse (e.g., tiny prompts that create lots of requests). Runtime needs to know whether to enforce hard cap vs soft alert.

lisa: billing note — overage pricing we discussed: two options: 1) auto-bill at marginal unit price, 2) throttle + invoice manual uplift. We need acceptance criteria for which customers get auto-billing. Also need usage export schema.

haley: UX acceptance criteria: limits UI must show: current usage, soft cap warnings 24h in advance, ability to upgrade to higher burst tiers, and clear language about eventual billing. Edgecase: swapping from dedicated to hosted — existing credits should map.

mia: Ok. Draft scope: must include: requirements, acceptance criteria, example API responses, metering semantics, and migration path for existing customers. Keep MVP small: token-based quotas + request-count fallback + billing toggle (auto-bill vs invoice).

dan: I'll sketch the API shape for quota checks. Copy/paste below — feedback welcome.

```json
POST /v1/quotas/check
Request:
{
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "model": "redwood-1",
  "tokens": 512,
  "request_type": "generation"
}

Response (200):
{
  "allowed": true,
  "remaining_tokens": 12488,
  "window_expires_at": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
  "enforcement": "soft"  // values: soft, hard, throttled
}
```

sanjay: For runtime we need enforcement typed: soft -> warn + metric; hard -> reject 403; throttled -> delay and return Retry-After. Add `billing_unit` to response for metering.

lisa: add `billing_unit` and `metering_key` so we can export. Also include `currency` and `rate_per_unit` in the invoice export; PRD should call out rounding rules and proration on plan changes.

haley: edgecases to capture in PRD: 
- multiple concurrent requests that race remaining_tokens to negative (atomicity)
- switching from shared pool to dedicated mid-window
- refunds when generated output is abusive and we need to credit back

mia: Good list. Acceptance criteria draft (MVP):
- API responds within 50ms p95 for quota check on hosted tier
- Billing export generates CSV/JSON with fields: customer_id, window_start, window_end, tokens_consumed, billing_unit, rate, currency
- UI shows soft-warning at 80% usage and blocks at 100% if enforcement=hard
- Admins can toggle auto-bill per-customer

dan: Implementation notes to include in RFC: atomic decrement in the KV store (Lua script or compare-and-set), fallback to eventual consistency for shared pools with compensating billing reconciliation, and clear metric labels (`quota_check`, `quota_block`, `quota_warn`).

lisa: SLA/launch gating: billing export must be verified with two pilot customers, and accounting needs test vectors. We'll need sample invoices in PRD.

mia: Accept. Action items:
- dan: PRD draft (include API + acceptance criteria) — due EOW
- sanjay: runtime design + atomicity options — due EOW
- lisa: billing export schema + pricing decision doc (auto-bill vs invoice) — due Tue
- haley: UI acceptance mockups + copy for warnings — due Tue

deploy-bot: RFC template: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/template. Use tags: `quota`, `billing`, `mvp`.

mia: Also add a short migration section: map existing customers with per-request limits to token model using historical conversion rates. Put sample conversion formula in PRD.

dan: one more — rate-limits for embeddings: should we meter by embedding vector dimension? too messy. propose treat embeddings as tokens-equivalent (embedding_tokens = words_estimate * 1.2). Call it out as heuristic.

sanjay: Agree on heuristic. Add a note: revisit when we support model-level observable FLOPs.

mia: Great. I'll compile notes into the PRD skeleton and tag reviewers. Thanks all. :rocket:

haley: thumbs up. I'll start mocks after Lisa's pricing decision. :+1:

lisa: added billing test vectors to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/quotas/billing-test-vectors (internal)

done: thread closed for now, reopen if blockers crop up.
